_note: D-001 repeats D-1 by number; the second PD-1 repeats the first; the D-2 heading inside a fence repeats D-2 (nothing is skipped: a fence, a comment or front matter hides no heading). D-3 and D-4 repeat after a `<!--` written as text and after a fenced `<!--` with a `-->` later. An id quoted in a body paragraph is never read as a declaration.
